# Command pytest

```text
Usage: pytest [OPTIONS] [FILES]
Options:
  -k EXPRESSION       Select matching tests.
  -q, --quiet         Reduce verbosity.
  --maxfail NUM       Stop after failures. [default: 0]
Arguments:
  FILES               Tests to collect.
```

## Configuration TOML tool.pytest.ini_options.addopts
Type: string
Default: ""
Additional command-line options.
